Background

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that delivery business value across the organization. This role is focused on building AI applications and services at scale. You will be responsible for building robust, secure, and highly scalable systems that integrate with leading cloud-based AI services.

You will work alongside product managers, designers, and other engineers as an individual contributor. You are expected to own features end-to-end, and to deliver high-quality, reusable code that scales beyond a single use case.

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering and Execution

Design, build, and ship production-grade Generative and Agentic AI features and applications
Own features end-to-end from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and operation
Build reusable, well-abstracted components and shared utilities (e.g., RAG building blocks, agent scaffolding, evaluation harnesses, prompt utilities) to enable faster delivery of future Generative and Agentic AI products
Build multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK
Integrate with leading LLM and foundation model APIs, including Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking
Build clean, well-tested RESTful and/or gRPC APIs with a focus on reliability, security, and performance
Implement observability, tracing, evaluation, guardrails for Generative and Agentic AI applications
Deploy and operate services on major cloud providers (e.g., GCP, AWS, and Azure) leveraging managed services
Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, sharing knowledge with peers

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of professional software engineering experience with at least 3 years of experience building AI/ML software products
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master’s degree preferred)
Strong proficiency in Python, with deep software engineering fundamentals (abstraction, modularity, system design, testing, performance)
Hands-on experience building and shipping Generative and Agentic AI applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, and/or agentic workflows
Practical experience integrating cloud-hosted LLM APIs such as Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and/or AWS Bedrock
Experience with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Open Search, AlloyDB)
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Azure
Solid understanding of API design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture
Track record of taking systems from design through production deployment and operation

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of Generative AI Risk Management frameworks (NIST RFM)
Experience supporting developer platforms or internal tooling

jobs.job_description:
POSITION SUMMARY 

 

In this role, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing AI-driven tooling and automation to transform and enhance the operations of a critical cloud-based platform. Your primary responsibility will be to identify operational challenges and build intelligent solutions that automate repetitive tasks, accelerate incident detection and resolution, improve observability, and enable more proactive and predictive operations. 

 

You will work closely with SRE, DevOps, engineering, and platform teams to leverage Generative AI, machine learning, automation frameworks, and operational data to build practical AI-powered solutions for production environments. This will include developing AI agents, intelligent automation workflows, operational assistants, automated alert triage and correlation, root-cause analysis capabilities, and predictive monitoring solutions. 

 

The role will require a strong understanding of both software engineering and production operations, with a focus on taking AI solutions from concept and experimentation through to reliable, scalable production implementations. Your efforts will help reduce manual operational effort, improve incident response and resolution times, minimize operational risk, and establish a more intelligent, autonomous, and scalable operating model for the platform. 

 

 

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILL SETS 

Education: Bachelor's degree or master's in computer science, Engineering, Software Engineering or a relevant field 

Experience: Relevant 4+ years of experience in SRE, Production Support, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a similar technology role, with hands-on experience in Python-based automation and a strong interest or experience in applying AI/Generative AI to production operations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Design, develop, and implement AI-powered tooling and automation to improve the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of production operations. 

Identify repetitive, manual, and time-consuming operational activities and develop intelligent solutions to automate or significantly reduce human intervention. 

Build and productionize AI/Generative AI solutions for use cases such as incident triage, alert analysis and correlation, log analysis, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, and operational assistance. 

Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and automation frameworks that can assist or execute defined operational activities with appropriate controls and guardrails. 

Work closely with SRE, DevOps, Development, and Engineering teams to understand operational challenges and translate them into scalable AI and automation use cases. 

Integrate AI capabilities with existing SRE and production-support workflows, including monitoring, alerting, incident management, knowledge management platforms. 

Develop solutions that can proactively identify operational anomalies, assist with troubleshooting, recommend remediation actions, and support predictive operations. 

Measure the effectiveness of AI-driven automation through metrics such as reduction in manual effort, MTTR, alert noise, incident resolution time, and operational toil. 

Participate in the support of critical production systems and work with SRE/engineering teams during major incidents when AI-driven analysis or automation can accelerate investigation and resolution. 

Collaborate with stakeholders across time zones and cultures and engage with clients when required to understand operational challenges and demonstrate AI-driven solutions. 

Required Technical Skills 

Strong Python programming and automation development. 

Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, and prompt engineering. 

Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures. 

Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms. 

Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

Strong understanding of logging, alerting, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. 

Preferred Skills 

Exposure to LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar agent frameworks. 

Machine learning and anomaly-detection experience. 

Knowledge of vector databases and knowledge-retrieval systems. 

Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana or similar tools. 

Soft Skills 

Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset. 

Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and automate them. 

Effective stakeholder communication. 

Passion for innovation and applying AI to real-world operational challenges.

jobs.job_description:
The Opportunity
Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.
We have made a clear strategic choice: Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.
We are looking for a hands-on Technology AI leader who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems - quickly.
This is not a traditional IT leadership role.
You will own the intersection of business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security . You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.
Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.
We need someone who enjoys that challenge.




What You Will Own 1. Technology Execution Delivery
You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.
You will:
Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
Track commitments through completion - not merely development activity.
Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
Build clear visibility from:
Business Requirement Development Production Adoption Business Impact
Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.
Success means:
Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, Where is this project stuck and who owns it




2. Business-First Technology Strategy
Technology exists to improve business outcomes.
You will:
Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
Own the Technology AI roadmap based on impact on:
Revenue
Gross margin
Productivity
Operating cost
Speed
Customer/vendor experience
Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
Report technology performance to leadership in business outcomes rather than project activity .




3. AI, Agents Intelligent Automation
AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.
You will:
Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into real production environments .
Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
Integrate AI into areas including:
Catalogue and content
Marketplace listings
Pricing
Inventory
Customer support
Sales
Finance
HR
Reporting and decision support
Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
Measure:
hours/FTE capacity saved
cycle-time reduction
cost reduction
quality improvement
revenue/margin impact
user adoption
Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.
We are not looking for:
Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.
We are looking for:
Someone who has put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.




4. E-commerce Platforms Marketplace Technology
Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.
You will own and strengthen:
Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
Pricing and quantity synchronization.
Order processing.
Inventory and warehouse integrations.
Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
API reliability and monitoring.
You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.
The goal is not simply integration.
The goal is reliable commerce at scale .




5. Product Platform Ownership
You will take ownership of Ergode s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.
This includes:
evaluating existing architecture,
identifying technical debt,
establishing clear module ownership,
improving reliability and usability,
prioritising development based on business value,
and driving adoption after launch.
Technology is not complete when code is deployed.
A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.




6. Data Foundation Decision Intelligence
AI is only as strong as the underlying data.
You will:
Build reliable data flows across business systems.
Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
Improve data quality and ownership.
Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.




7. Architecture, Cloud Engineering Quality
You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.
You will:
Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
Prototype when speed requires it.
Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.
We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.




8. Security, Reliability AI Governance
You will own the reliability and security of Ergode s technology environment.
Responsibilities include:
Cloud and infrastructure reliability
Monitoring and uptime
Incident management
Root-cause analysis
Backups and disaster recovery
Identity and access management
SSO
Endpoint/device security
Data protection
You will also establish practical AI governance covering:
which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
permissions available to AI agents,
human review requirements for critical decisions,
auditability,
and acceptable AI use.
Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.




9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource
We do not believe everything must be built internally.
We do believe Ergode must own the outcome.
You will decide when to:
BUILD - when capability creates strategic advantage.
BUY - when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.
OUTSOURCE - when an external specialist can deliver faster.
For outsourced work, you will own:
requirements,
architecture,
vendor selection,
commercial evaluation,
milestones,
SLAs,
quality,
security,
source code,
documentation,
handover.
No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.




What Success Looks Like
Within the first 6-12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:
Execution
Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
Delivery predictability improves materially.
Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.
AI Automation
Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
Automation impact is quantified monthly.
Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.
Core Platforms
Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
Technical ownership and documentation improve.
Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.
Data
Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.
Business Partnership
Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect working solutions, not project discussions .




Who We Are Looking For Must-Haves
10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
Practical experience with:
LLM APIs
RAG
AI agents / agentic workflows
Python
workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
API/integration architecture experience.
DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
Experience managing external technology partners.
Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
Strong business and commercial orientation.
Strongly Preferred
Experience in one or more of:
E-commerce
Marketplaces
Retail technology
D2C
SaaS/platform businesses
ERP/OMS/WMS
Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
AI-first enterprise transformation




Who Will NOT Fit This Role
This role is probably not for you if:
Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
You require large teams before you can execute.
You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.




The Person Behind the Resume
We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.
We value people who demonstrate:
Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.
We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.
